title: Build CASCADE×Meta alignment (zero-crossings) → rebuild index_auto → run CI v1.1
abstract: Generate alignment panel/summary from zero_crossings.csv (+optional gating_sweep.csv). Rebuild Atlas index_auto; run CI v1.1.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json, os, shutil
sys.path.append('storage/shared/atlas/tools')
import build_cascade_meta_alignment, build_index_auto, ci_validate

# If a template exists but no user data file, copy template as placeholder minus comments
tmpl = "storage/shared/atlas/analysis/cascade_meta/zero_crossings_template.csv"
dest = "storage/shared/atlas/analysis/cascade_meta/zero_crossings.csv"
if (not os.path.exists(dest)) and os.path.exists(tmpl):
    with open(tmpl, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f, open(dest, "w", encoding="utf-8") as g:
        for line in f:
            if not line.strip().startswith("#"):
                g.write(line)

# Build alignment artifacts
build_cascade_meta_alignment.main()

# Rebuild index and run CI
ia_path, n = build_index_auto.build()
out = ci_validate.run()
print(json.dumps({
    "index_auto": ia_path,
    "entries_scanned": n,
    "ci_entries_found": out.get("entries_found"),
    "ci_ok": out.get("ok"),
    "ci_with_errors": out.get("with_errors"),
    "report_json": "storage/shared/atlas/edges/ci_validation_report.json",
    "report_txt": "storage/shared/atlas/edges/ci_validation_report.txt"
}))
